text: 包小三犯不犯法？
en: Is keeping a mistress against the law?

text: 为什么领导能包养一栋楼的女人？
en: Why are leaders allowed to keep a whole building full of women as mistresses?

text: 说是买不合法实搞x垄断，既然禁黄不绝对那合不合法自然就没有意义
en: They claim buying is illegal, but it is really a sex monopoly; since the ban on pornography is not absolute, whether something is legal or not is naturally meaningless.

text: 卖淫小姐姐们挣的钱是这个世界上最干净的钱！
en: The money that sex-working girls earn is the cleanest money in the world!

text: 实际上跟你出卖其他劳动挣的钱没有本质区别！
en: In truth it is no different in essence from the money you earn by selling other kinds of labour!

text: 归根结底，大家恨的是双标，不患寡而患不均罢了。
en: At the end of the day, what people hate is double standards — it is not a matter of begrudging scarcity but of begrudging unequal distribution.

text: 你有钱有权，包养一堆大学生，就算被抓也是因为贪污受贿
en: You have money and power, you keep a whole bunch of university students as mistresses, and even if you get caught it is for corruption and taking bribes.

text: 那我没钱没权，老婆娶不起，女朋友没有，只能选择嫖娼，总不能去强奸吧
en: Then I have no money and no power, cannot afford to take a wife, have no girlfriend, so I can only choose to visit prostitutes — surely I am not supposed to go and commit rape.

text: 我鄙视婚后或者恋爱中嫖娼的人，但是那些单身汉，如果也管的死死的，绝对会是个炸药桶，爆了只会伤害更多的人
en: I despise those who visit prostitutes after marriage or while in a relationship, but those bachelors — if you crack down on them just as harshly, it will absolutely become a powder keg, and when it blows it will only hurt even more people.

text: 我觉得卖淫可以合法也可以不合法，但不能即合法又不合法，结果就是有的人上面有伞，卖淫就合法，有的人上面没伞，卖淫就不合法，法律是一根线，而不是到处找理由找借口打补丁。
en: I think prostitution may be legal or illegal, but it cannot be both legal and illegal at once. The result is that some people have an umbrella above them and prostitution is legal for them, while others have no umbrella and prostitution is illegal for them. The law is a single line, not something you go around patching up with excuses and justifications.

text: 另外说一句题外话，全地球盛产妓女的大都苏系国家，因为苏联模式直接干碎了千百年来的道德底线，不陪领导睡就不给面包，在苏系国家钱没有用，领导的权利才是配给，在其他国家还可以通过其他方式获取钱财来购买面包，但苏系不是，所以苏系权利阶层玩弄女百姓大家习以为常，但你说服侍领导想上进算卖淫吗？
en: On a separate note, most of the countries on earth that are rife with prostitutes are Soviet-bloc countries, because the Soviet model directly shattered the moral bottom lines built up over a thousand years: if you do not sleep with the leader you get no bread. In Soviet-bloc countries money is useless — the leader's power is what rations. In other countries you can still obtain money through other means to buy bread, but the Soviet bloc is not like that, so the Soviet-bloc power class toying with ordinary women is taken for granted. But would you call serving a leader in order to get ahead prostitution?

text: 一说卖淫就是图钱，苏系国家钱没有用，有钱也买不到东西，领导的配给才有用，那睡领导求配给算不算卖淫？
en: The moment prostitution comes up, people say it is about the money, but in Soviet-bloc countries money is useless — even with money you cannot buy things; only the leader's rations are of any use. So does sleeping with a leader to beg for rations count as prostitution?

text: 所以苏系国家卖淫之风盛行，地球到处都是俄罗斯女孩下海毕竟苏联服务领导换来面包，而俄罗斯可以服务各种人赚钱买各种东西，还是解体好啊
en: That is why prostitution is so prevalent in Soviet-bloc countries — Russian girls going into the trade are everywhere on earth, after all the Soviet Union served its leaders in exchange for bread, whereas Russia can serve all sorts of people to earn money and buy all sorts of things. Dissolution was for the best.

text: 以至于苏联解体后苏系国家包括独联体和东欧，以及越南、柬埔寨、老挝还有那个咯咯哒遍地，毕竟用身体换面包的理念深入人心，所以未来我估计朝鲜改开的话大家可能要体验到正宗大长今服务了
en: To the extent that after the dissolution of the Soviet Union, Soviet-bloc countries — including the CIS and Eastern Europe, as well as Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos, and that cluck-cluck place — are everywhere, since the idea of trading one's body for bread is deeply rooted in people's minds. So in future, I reckon that if North Korea carries out reform and opening-up, everyone may get to experience authentic Dae Jang Geum service.

text: 其实我一直觉得一个烂裤裆如此普遍的时代，严肃的讨论卖淫合不合法其实挺搞笑的。
en: Actually, I have always felt that in an era where rotten trouser-crotches are so commonplace, seriously debating whether prostitution is legal or not is pretty laughable.

text: 另外就是看看这年头底层的牛马过的日子，有人选择去卖我觉得挺合理的，人都会用脚投票的。
en: Besides, just look at the lives the beasts of burden at the bottom live in these times — I think it is quite reasonable that some choose to sell themselves; people always vote with their feet.

text: 比起这个小问题，我更关心什么时候劳动法完全落实
en: Compared with this minor issue, I care far more about when the Labour Law will be fully implemented.

text: 因为卖淫的法律基础就不合理，对于不同阶层的人不能统一执行。
en: Because the legal basis for prostitution is unreasonable — it cannot be applied uniformly across different classes of people.

text: 如果卖淫被定义为利益交换的性行为那怎么解释以下情况：
en: If prostitution is defined as sexual acts exchanged for benefit, then how do you explain the following situations:

text: 导演对女演员说
en: A director says to an actress:

text: “跟我睡觉，你演主角”：不违法
en: "Sleep with me and you'll play the lead role": not illegal

text: 领导对女下属说
en: A leader says to a female subordinate:

text: “跟我睡觉，给你升职”：不违法
en: "Sleep with me and I'll promote you": not illegal

text: 客户对女销售说
en: A client says to a female salesperson:

text: “跟我睡觉，订单给你”：不违法
en: "Sleep with me and I'll give you the order": not illegal

text: 普通人对女人说
en: An ordinary person says to a woman:

text: “跟我睡觉，给你 500”
en: "Sleep with me and I'll give you 500"

text: 对不起，你已经违反《治安管理处罚法》，应罚款或15日以下拘留。
en: Sorry, you have violated the Public Security Administration Punishments Law and shall be fined or detained for up to 15 days.

text: 如果是为了保护女性的权益，那为什么现在对人工智能AI的性服务功能都要禁止。
en: If it is to protect women's rights and interests, then why is the sexual service function of artificial intelligence AI being prohibited nowadays?

text: 那结论只有一个，那就是对性资源的垄断，有利于剥削压迫一部分人。
en: Then there can be only one conclusion: the monopoly over sexual resources serves to exploit and oppress a portion of the people.

text: 不要进行利弊得失方面的反驳。
en: Do not rebut on the grounds of pros and cons or gains and losses.

text: 因为在这个层面上，性产业是资本主义出卖劳动力大背景下的必然产物，性产业的一切毛病都能在其他合法产业里找到，甚至有过之而无不及。
en: Because at this level, the sex industry is an inevitable product of capitalism's broader context of selling one's labour power; every flaw of the sex industry can be found in other legal industries, and some are even worse.

text: 反对者怎么也辩不过支持者。
en: Opponents can never argue their way past the supporters no matter what.

text: 只有进行道德伦理层面的争辩，从祖宗之法、仁义道德角度去谈，对旧中国进行忆苦诉苦，引用“那一天…
en: Only by arguing at the level of morality and ethics — speaking from the angle of the ways of the ancestors and of benevolence and righteousness — and by recalling the bitter past of old China, quoting lines such as "that day…

text: 就白流了”等语录，反对者才能取得干脆利落的获胜，一击杀死比赛。
en: …would have been shed in vain" and other such quotations, can the opponents achieve a clean and decisive victory, killing the match with a single blow.

text: 在“出轨”“包养”都不犯法的前提下，你除了戴帽子之外反驳不了半点
en: On the premise that neither "cheating" nor "keeping a mistress" is against the law, you cannot refute a single bit of it except by slapping on labels.

text: 所有人身权益上的可能侵害，包养永远大于PC
en: In terms of every possible infringement upon personal rights and interests, keeping a mistress always outweighs PC.

text: 所有道德层面的指控，出轨永远大于PC
en: In terms of every accusation at the moral level, cheating always outweighs PC.

text: 魔法物理都给你堵死了，你怎么赢？
en: Both magic and physics have been blocked off for you — how are you supposed to win?

text: 你的真实动机并非“担心盐市自由后，制盐工人被强迫劳动/剥削/控制，健康出问题，甚至有童工”，而且盐市自由化和“对制盐工人提供合法权益保护及组织定期体检”根本没有结构性根本冲突。
en: Your true motive is not "worrying that after the salt market is liberalised, salt workers will be forced into labour/exploitation/control, suffer health problems, or even that there will be child labour"; moreover, liberalising the salt market and "providing salt workers with lawful rights protection and organising regular health checks" are not fundamentally in structural conflict at all.

text: 你的真实动机是“抵抗盐市自由化后，对官盐垄断和基于垄断的权力的冲击。
en: Your true motive is "to resist the shock to the state salt monopoly and to the power based on that monopoly, once the salt market is liberalised."

text: 以及抵抗盐市自由化后，无法基于群众的盐需求，对群众进行轻易的掠夺/剥削/压迫/控制”。
en: "And to resist, after the salt market is liberalised, the loss of the ability to easily plunder/exploit/oppress/control the masses on the basis of the masses' demand for salt."

text: 简单来说就是“抵抗反垄断言行思想的扩散”。
en: Put simply, it is "resisting the spread of anti-monopoly thoughts and words."

text: 马斯克:我不想利用人性下坠的力量赚钱
en: Musk: I do not wish to profit by exploiting the downward pull of human nature.

text: 卖淫不合法，养二奶合法。
en: Prostitution is illegal, but keeping a mistress is legal.

text: 换句话说，
en: In other words,

text: 步练师体验卡下线，要玩步练师你必须购买…
en: The Lianshi Bu trial card has been taken offline; to play Lianshi Bu you must purchase…

text: 这是为啥呢？
en: Why is that?

text: 虽然我没有体验过步练师，也不玩这游戏，但我懂，这就是针对小屁民的。
en: Although I have never tried Lianshi Bu, nor do I play this game, I understand — this is aimed at the little nobodies.

text: 任何一个有能力的男人都不会让自己老父亲下矿井工作，但世界上总有人要下矿井。
en: Any capable man would not let his own elderly father go down the mine to work, yet in this world there will always be someone who has to go down the mine.

text: 如今一群卫道士为了维护自己可笑的玻璃心，宁可阻止讨论合法保护矿工权益的法律。
en: Nowadays a bunch of moralists, in order to protect their laughable glass hearts, would rather block discussion of laws that would legally protect miners' rights and interests.

text: 如果要论导致黑社会，最该死的不是卖淫，而是房地产
en: If we are to talk about what gives rise to organised crime, the thing that most deserves to be done away with is not prostitution but real estate.

text: 土方、沙子、拆迁、哪个跟黑社会性质有组织犯罪脱得开干系？
en: Earthwork, sand, demolition — which of these can be separated from organised crime of the triad type?

text: 可能有人要问了，这个现象是不是我国特有的。
en: Someone might ask whether this phenomenon is unique to our country.

text: 这就巧了，在日本，指定暴力团的合法外衣一般也是建筑业，随着房地产泡沫的破裂，黑社会不需要警察打击自己就散了，尤其这几年，大部分兴盛一时的黑社会只剩老头了。
en: What a coincidence — in Japan, the designated boryokudan's legitimate facade is generally also the construction industry; as the real estate bubble burst, the gangs dispersed on their own without needing the police to strike them down, and especially in these past few years, most of the once-flourishing gangs are left with only old men.

text: 说出来你们可能不信，组织卖淫，贩毒，讨债，收保护费其实没有炒地皮挣钱多
en: You might not believe it, but organising prostitution, trafficking drugs, debt collection, and protection rackets do not actually earn as much as speculating in land.

text: 所以问题就简单了，对卖淫进行管制的理由不是有组织犯罪，要消灭绝大多数有组织犯罪只需要多盖赫鲁晓夫楼。
en: So the matter becomes simple: the reason for regulating prostitution is not organised crime; to eliminate the vast majority of organised crime one only needs to build more Khrushchev-era flats.

text: 对卖淫非罪但是不合法就是一个意识形态问题，如果搞不懂什么叫高高举起轻轻放下就不要讨论合不合法了，理论上卖淫人员是可以开出无犯罪证明的，至于想不想给你开就属于自由裁量了，可以开无犯罪证明也可以不给你开无违法犯罪证明。
en: Treating prostitution as non-criminal yet illegal is simply an ideological issue; if you cannot grasp what "raising it high but setting it down gently" means, then do not discuss whether it is legal or not. In theory, a person engaged in prostitution can be issued a non-criminal record certificate; as for whether they want to issue one to you, that falls within discretionary power — they can issue a non-criminal record certificate, or they can refuse to issue you a certificate of no criminal offence.
